diagnostic_scope.issue_1: Export UI shows per-site selection instead of GLOBAL mode RetailOps product-level card
diagnostic_scope.issue_3: Classification/core attributes do not affect readiness and cannot be changed (persistence bug)

issue_1_legacy_ui.description: Export UI shows SITE_SCOPED mode (legacy panel + site selector) because settings/exportSettings.exportGlobalMode.enabled is false
issue_1_legacy_ui.explanation: This is expected governance behavior - flag must be explicitly enabled to activate GLOBAL mode UI

code_citations.purpose: Reads Firestore flag, returns GLOBAL or SITE_SCOPED
Integrates feature mode, adds mode field to response if GLOBAL
Frontend mode detection with SITE_SCOPED default
Conditional rendering: GlobalModeCard if mode=GLOBAL, else legacy panel

issue_1_legacy_ui.resolution: No fix needed - Lisa must enable flag after Phase 2B HES C verification completes

issue_2_classification_attributes_bug.root_cause: String literal mismatch in requirement flag check
issue_2_classification_attributes_bug.description: Completion evaluation engine uses hardcoded string 'completionRequired' but Firestore config specifies 'required_for_completion' - strings never match, causing requirement flag filter to never execute
issue_2_classification_attributes_bug.impact: Classification attributes (category, class, department) marked as required_for_completion:true in registry are not being enforced. Products show as complete even when these attributes missing. Affects ALL segments using requirement flags (core attributes AND SEO attributes).

code_citations.issue: Hardcoded string 'completionRequired' never matches config value 'required_for_completion'

code_citations.purpose: Complete attribute resolution logic showing bug context

option_a_recommended.rationale: Use dynamic property access to match any requirement flag name

option_b_not_recommended.approach: Change Firestore config requirementFlag values to 'completionRequired'
option_b_not_recommended.issue: Requires registry schema change, breaks existing config pattern

issue_2_classification_attributes_bug.next_steps: Create new LP to implement Option A fix, test classification attribute enforcement

issue_3_attribute_persistence.description: Attribute changes (e.g., gender, category) do not persist after save and refresh. Requires browser-based verification with DevTools network traces.
issue_3_attribute_persistence.blocker: No staging deployment available for browser-based testing
evidence_needed: DevTools network trace of attribute save request
HTTP response body and status code
issue_3_attribute_persistence.hypothesis: May be related to requirementFlag bug (Issue 2) - if classification attributes not enforced, frontend may allow null/empty values or skip validation
issue_3_attribute_persistence.next_steps: Deploy to staging, reproduce bug, capture network traces and console logs
